# MH-03 — Receive confirmation

**Business value:** 980

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a hiker

I want to receive confirmation containing the details of my booking

So that I know the reservation was successful


## Notes

Notification is sent via email to the hiker who made the reservation.

<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

The email contains 
- a booking reference,
- the date and time slot,
- the party size
- possible party requirements (e.g. allergies)
- the name of the hiker that made the reservation
